ModMetaData.name: Seren Original Masks
ModMetaData.author: OdysseyLotus, Lucius - 1.6 adapted by Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Adds the twelve body masks of the original Seren mod to the Biotech fork of Seren, as body genes: a galaxy halo with a bright star, a sun starburst, constellations, a layered cape. One gene per mask, and only one body mask is worn at a time, like the fork's own.
The original masks are drawn for a Humanoid Alien Races skin colour channel. Here they are plain textures that the gene tints, so the colour comes from the gene and not from the skin.
Requires [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3726565301]Seren, from Stardust [Biotech Fork][/url]. Not affiliated with it, and it does not need the original mod.
[b]Thanks[/b] to OdysseyLotus for Seren and its masks, and to Lucius for the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3726565301]Biotech fork[/url]. Both are CC0. The original is [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2704627783]Seren, from Stardust[/url]. The captures were taken with Pickle, a development tool that is never a dependency.
[b]Made with AI.[/b] The conversion of the masks and the assembly were done with Claude Code, which the commit history records as a co-author.
[b]Adoption.[/b] If I do not answer within a reasonable time after being contacted, anyone may freely update this or any other of my mods, including publishing a continuation of it. All credit must be preserved.
